summary:
Implementation plan to fix the Cine Details screen:
- Display seasons and episodes accurately for all TV shows (whether from Search, OTT Discovery rail, Extensions, or Local Library).
- Fix loadExtensionItemDetails to preserve fallbackType = TvType.TvSeries so TV shows are never falsely treated as MovieLoadResponse.
- Unify seasons and episodes fetching so TV shows query TMDB or provider seasons and episodes dynamically.
- Modernize CineDetailView layout into a full-screen modal overlay with a prominent back button, clean top scrim, and modern episode list.
- Clean up the CineHub top bar UI with a compact logo and title, plus an integrated overflow dropdown menu for actions, eliminating cramped icon overcrowding.
